items.title: New CSS Attacks Can Break Webmail Defenses to Steal Passwords and Tokens
items.summary: New research shows content inside an email can escape its message boundary and interfere with the webmail interface. items.title: More than half of AI-generated patches are broken
items.summary: Research finds your AI generated security patch is more likely to fail than fully fix a vulnerability. It might even introduce brand new flaws to exploit along the way. The post More than half of AI-generated patches are broken appeared first on CyberScoop .

items.title: AI-Generated Patches Fail Half the Time
items.summary: A study of more than 6,000 patches found that even working patches can introduce new bugs, break something else, or are open to bypass.
